name: Banh trang phoi suong
summary: A two-layer rice sheet from Trảng Bàng, toasted over a peanut-shell fire until small bubbles show and the sheet is still pale, then rested in dew. Roll it with boiled pork or boiled young beef, herbs, and a dipping sauce. The dew time and the sauce are printed more than one way. A stall price is Check on arrival.
origin: Trảng Bàng, Tây Ninh. The provincial tourism craft page and the 2024 national tourism article describe the sheet. After 1 July 2025 the ward is phường Trảng Bàng. The articles still say thị trấn Trảng Bàng.
history: The tourism information center says the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism entered the Trảng Bàng craft in the national intangible-heritage list in 2015. The provincial craft page dates that recognition to 2016. Both years stay.
The tourism information center also says some Trảng Bàng producers hold national OCOP 4-star and 5-star recognition for the sheets.
texture: The 2024 article in Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam describes a two-layer sheet, a peanut-shell kiln, and a pale sheet with small bubbles. The dew rest has to stay short or the sheet goes damp.

The Trảng Bàng town page says the dew rest is one or two minutes, enough to soften the sheet without soaking it. The 2024 article says the dew is near dawn and must stay short. Both times stay. The provincial craft page calls the dew step the one that decides the sheet.
taste: The Trảng Bàng town page names fish sauce with garlic and chili. The national rural-tourism page names tamarind fish sauce. The older tourism article says the Gia Huỳnh sauces run sour and sweet. All three stay.
howToEat: Roll the sheet with boiled pork or boiled young beef and a handful of herbs. The provincial craft page names mặt trăng, trâm ổi, chùm mòi, quế vị, cóc, rau nhái, and lộc vừng.

The young-beef article describes a different roll of the same sheet: thin slices of steamed or boiled young beef, fresh rice noodles, garden herbs, and forest leaves, dipped in mắm nêm or mixed fish sauce. Those leaves are quế vị, lá cách, đọt cóc, sao nhái, and cải trời.
Dew-making is a dawn job. Eating is not limited to dawn. A stall price is Check on arrival. The hour at the table is Check on arrival.
where: Sit in khu phố Gia Huỳnh. The yards where the sheets are poured, dried, and toasted are khu phố Lộc Du. Trảng Bàng sits on Quốc lộ 22 toward Mộc Bài, and Quốc lộ 22B toward the old town.
seoTitle: Banh trang phoi suong in Tay Ninh
seoDescription: Trảng Bàng rice paper, toasted, then rested in dew for one or two minutes or for a short time near dawn. Roll it with pork or young beef. A price is Check on arrival.
